regions.name: Dialogue: select a message (slot `$800C`)
regions.description: X = an object slot whose `$0620,X` holds the message number 0-20: `$05C0,X/$05D8,X` := the 16-bit pointer `$960F + 2 x number` (the pointer table in front of the dialogue script). Called when a type-`$34` message object is created. RUN: all 21 pointers equal the table.

regions.name: Dialogue: fetch the next two characters (slot `$800F`)
regions.description: Adds `$0638,X` (the bytes consumed last time) to the object's message pointer, stores it back, and reads two bytes: `$15` := the current character, `$14` := the one after it (a look-ahead), then `$0638,X` := 1. So each call advances one character. The script's controls are `$00` end of message, `$01` end of screenful, `$0D` end of line. RUN: for every message the first six calls returned (byte k, byte k+1) of the script.

regions.name: SCENE LOADER (slot `$8000`; A = scene 0-38): scene record
regions.description: SCENE LOADER (slot `$8000`; A = scene 0-38): `$1A:$1B` := `$AD91 + 3 x scene`: the scene's record `[tile list][metatile-set record][palette record]`, each an index or `$FF` for none. RUN: all 39 scenes called on the labyrinth savestate (bank 5 live) and compared with an independent decode of the tables.

regions.name: Scene loader: keep X
regions.description: `TXA / PHA`: the caller's X is saved (restored at `$AD8E`).

regions.name: Scene loader: a tile list?
regions.description: Byte 0 of the record `$FF` goes to the set record (`$AD0C`).

regions.name: Scene loader: the tile list
regions.description: `$16:$17` := `$AE06 + 2 x index`'s pointer. A tile list is `[count]` then count x `[tile][bank][block]`.

regions.name: Scene loader: tile list count
regions.description: X := count.

regions.name: Scene loader: where the tiles go
regions.description: `$19:$18` := PPU `$1000 + 16 x tile`: the list's first byte is a tile number of pattern table 1 (the background table).

regions.name: Scene loader: the bank
regions.description: `$10` := the bank the block lives in (1-3); the stream position is saved on the stack.

regions.name: Scene loader: the block
regions.description: A block byte with bit 7 clear is the block number; with bit 7 set it is relative to the scene: (byte AND `$0F`) + (`$5C` AND `$0F`), so one list serves scenes whose art follows their number (the corridors' common scenes).

regions.name: Scene loader: arm the decompressor
regions.description: Y := bank, A := block, `JSR $C042` (`$D7F9`) arms the NMI-driven tile decompressor for PPU `$19:$18`; next entry until the count reaches 0. The decompression runs in the background; callers wait with `$C045`.

regions.name: Scene loader: the metatile sets
regions.description: Byte 1 of the record: `$FF` skips to the palette; else `JSR $AD1A` with it.

regions.name: Load a metatile-set record (slot `$8027`)
regions.description: A = index into `$AE24`: `[count]` then count x `[set | list << 4][tile base][pointer lo][pointer hi]`. For each: `$0478 + set` := the object list (high nibble), `$0470 + set` := the tile base added to the metatile's tiles, `$0460/$0468 + set` := the set's address. RUN: equal to the independent decode for all 39 scenes.

regions.name: Scene loader: the palette record
regions.description: Byte 2 of the record: `$FF` skips. A palette record at `$AE50 + 2 x index` is `[flags][list pointer]` + (if flags bit 1) 8 bytes: the list goes to the palette walker `$C05D` (`$D92D`), and the 8 bytes into `$0199-$01A0`, the attribute patterns. RUN: palette RAM and patterns equal the decode for all scenes.

regions.name: Scene loader: return
regions.description: `PLA / TAX / RTS`.

regions.name: Copy a palette (slot `$8018`)
regions.description: A = palette 0-35, Y = position 0-7: the three colours of `$B30A + 3 x A` go to `$0181 + 3 x Y`. X and Y are preserved. This is what the palette walker `$D92D` calls for each list entry.
